name: David R. Walker
message: My name is David Walker. I have fill out and return these forms over and over at least 7 to 8 times a year doing the last 5 years. I have not got any kind of return or savings let alone any gifts. I'm at the point to say these is a lost of my stamp money and a useless time of filling these never hear anything turns out. So please tell me what is the reason. I would really like to know. Thank you.
